# Shared Hraness presentation

These local assets are immutable snapshots. Product layout and copy belong in
`site/style.css` and `site/index.html`; do not edit the upstream snapshots.

| Directory | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `hraness-paper` | Paper contract 1 from `hraness/design-kit` commit `0e089bc18f9a0409f0e74b1fb7192f468956e386` |
| `hraness-marketing` | Editorial/minimal marketing contract 1 from that same design-kit commit |
| `nebula-sans` | Unmodified Book 400, Medium 500 and Semibold 600 WOFF2 cuts from that same design-kit commit |
| `hraness-appearance` | Shared browser appearance menu and CSS from `hraness/design-kit` v0.13.0, commit `655bdb6d84ca69a419a3906efc6a03e1b19396ca` |
| `hraness-foil` | The shared metallic brand contract extracted byte-exact from that commit's `src/product-marketing.css`; regenerate with `bun scripts/build-site-foil.ts` |
| `hraness-site-footer` | Complete static footer CSS from `hraness/site-footer` v0.15.0, commit `3f29aaa1116205b86a0a65d779120532aeb2cc5d` |

Paper and marketing were copied byte-for-byte from the corresponding
`styles/vendor` directories in `hraness/peopleblade` commit
`900f5bfd922d603403c780e8431d76fb1ee7677f`. Their existing `provenance.json`
files retain the original source paths and SHA-256 hashes. The other two
directories record the same information for their selected upstream files.
`nebula-sans/fonts.css` is the small Sys1-owned font registration adapter.

Load Nebula's `fonts.css`, Paper's `paper-theme.css`, marketing's
`product-marketing-preset.css`, the shared `foil.css`, and the footer's
complete `stylex.css` before the product stylesheet. The wordmark carries the
metallic contract: `data-foil` and `hraness-foil-text` on the brand link, the
mark wrapped in `hraness-foil-mark` with its `--hraness-foil-mask` paint
layer, and `attachFoil` mounted by the appearance bundle. Retain the relative font and SVG paths. There is no
runtime CDN, font download service, React requirement, or Lantern dependency.

Use `data-hraness-theme="paper"` and `data-palette="paper"` on the root.
Without an explicit `data-theme`, Paper follows the operating system; `light`
or `dark` selects a mode. The marketing ancestor opts in with
`data-hraness-marketing-preset="editorial"`; `.hraness-marketing-field` applies
the static background. Instrument Serif is a regular 400 face; do not
synthesize bold. Body/UI text uses Nebula Sans and code uses system monospace.

The footer markup is generated by the pinned `dist/index.js` export
`renderHranessSiteFooter({ mailingList: { kind: "none" }, placement: "sticky" })`.
The pinned renderer has no consent opt-out and includes an inactive hidden
consent subtree. The Sys1-owned `adapt-static-footer.mjs` removes that exact
subtree and its unsupported action/copy, leaving the shared attribution and
social links intact. The renderer digest, parameters, adapter digest and final
fragment digest are retained in the footer provenance. The page embeds that
fragment; it enables no mailing list, paid support, consent runtime, form
submission, external script or background request.

The shared CSS, texture SVGs and footer are MIT licensed; keep their LICENSE
files and the footer's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Nebula Sans and Instrument Serif
retain their included SIL Open Font License and upstream provenance. These
assets do not include Peopleblade's product logo or illustrations.

For an update, select an immutable reviewed source, retain its source/hash
manifest, verify every admitted file and relative CSS asset URL, and inspect
the resulting site in both themes. The marketing snapshot includes its
dependency-free `check.mjs` integrity verifier.

## Shared appearance menu

`site/appearance.js` bundles the shared `installAppearanceMenus` export with
the small Sys1 entry in `scripts/site-appearance.js`. It runs synchronously in
the head, before styles, preserving the existing `sys1-appearance` storage
key. The shared stylesheet supplies the icon trigger and radio menu; no local
menu controller or native select is kept. All seven pages use the same
progressive markup. The header opts into the shared marketing paint and stays
visible on scroll. Product SVG styles do not override shared icons.

To reproduce the bundle, check out the exact design-kit commit in
`hraness-appearance/provenance.json`, install its frozen lockfile with Bun
1.3.14, and run from this repository:

```sh
bun scripts/build-site-appearance.ts /path/to/design-kit/dist/browser/index.js
```

The script verifies the committed upstream artifact digest before bundling.
The manifest records the CSS, license and emitted bundle hashes. Routine site
deployment serves these committed static files and requires no sibling
checkout or runtime dependency. Preserve the upstream and icon notices.

The sticky footer uses its own reserved footprint and safe-area sizing; do not
add a second spacer or fixed footer. The v0.15.0 renderer and static consent
adapter remain unchanged; only the placement option and fragment digest change.
